note: The RAW corpus, not an evaluation release. docs/DECISIONS.md D065 accepted the gated terms and inspected one shard; D071 indexed all 19,495 with ranged reads and never downloaded one. Shards are WebDataset tars holding h265 MP4s plus a per-clip JSON sidecar carrying factory_id/worker_id/duration_sec/fps/width/height/codec -- the only real worker_id in this project, and the reason H2's cluster bootstrap is measured here. Every field above is live-resolved via HfApi().dataset_info(), never transcribed. gated='auto' means terms-acceptance, not manual approval: D044's 403 was un-accepted terms, not a denial.
